evidence.evidence_text: To answer this question, we propose AnaloBench, a benchmark to determine analogical reasoning ability in LMs.
We collect a set of 340 high quality, human written analogies for use in our benchmark, which constitutes the largest such collection to date.
We then test a broad collection of models consisting of 12 open source and 3 proprietary in various sizes and architectures.
